headline: Summit Sunrise Reservations Require Official Planning
reservation: Access to the Summit District for sunrise between 3 AM and 7 AM requires a specific vehicle reservation booked through the official park system. This is separate from the park entry fee; accommodations like wilderness cabins and campgrounds require distinct booking procedures through official channels. Always check current release windows and availability directly as systems may change.

days.title: Summit Volcanic Landscapes

stops.name: Kalahaku Overlook
stops.detail: View the vast volcanic crater and distinctive silversword plants from a stable vantage point.

stops.name: Keoneheehee Trail
stops.detail: Walk a short out-and-back section of the Sliding Sands to experience the high-altitude volcanic scale.

days.driving: Allow 2 hours for the winding ascent; conditions vary
days.note: Temperatures at 10,000 feet are significantly lower than coastal areas.

days.title: Kipahulu Coastal Rainforest

stops.name: Pipiwai Trail
stops.detail: Hike through the bamboo forest toward Waimoku Falls, remaining mindful of slippery terrain.

stops.name: Kuloa Point Trail
stops.detail: Observe the Oheo Gulch coastal scenery where streams meet the Pacific Ocean.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes from Hana; conditions vary by rainfall
days.note: Flash flooding can close stream access even when it is sunny at the trailhead.

days.title: Upcountry and Higher Viewpoints

stops.name: Leleiwi Overlook
stops.detail: A short walk offers panoramic views of the crater and potential cloud inversions.

stops.name: Pu'u Ula'ula Summit
stops.detail: Reach the highest accessible point for a 360-degree view of Maui and neighboring islands.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours from central Maui; conditions vary
days.note: High altitude can cause physical exertion to feel more strenuous; stay hydrated.

intel.title: Summit Lot Capacity
intel.text: Parking at the very top is limited and can reach capacity during popular daytime hours. Utilize lower overlooks if the summit visitor center lots are restricted by staff.

intel.title: Connectivity Limits
intel.text: Cellular service is unreliable or absent throughout the park's volcanic interior and coastal trails. Download digital maps and official guides before leaving your gateway town.

intel.title: Upcountry Fueling
intel.text: There are no gas stations within the park boundaries or on the long ascent. Refill in Kahului, Pukalani, or Kula before beginning the drive to the summit district.

intel.title: Sunrise Window
intel.text: Visitors with reservations must arrive during their designated entry window to be admitted. Late arrivals may be denied entry to the summit area during the restricted hours.

intel.title: District Separation
intel.text: The Summit and Kipahulu districts are not connected by a park road. Reaching both requires driving around the island, which can take several hours depending on the route.

plan.arrival: Pick up your rental at Kahului (OGG) and secure supplies in Pukalani before checking into your Upcountry lodging.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the paved summit road; check rental agreements for restrictions on the unpaved portions of the back road to Hana.
plan.goldenHour: Kalahaku Overlook offers dramatic crater lighting as the sun sets, subject to seasonal cloud cover.
